title: Step through Bresenham
heading: Right, or right and down?
description: Bresenham’s line algorithm keeps an integer decision value D. For this line, dx = 7 columns and dy = 3 rows, so D starts at 2 × 3 − 7 = −1. Step forward and watch how D chooses the next pixel.

explanation.title: One decision per column
explanation.text: D < 0: move right and add 6 to D. D ≥ 0: move right and down, subtract 14, then add 6. Here 6 is 2 × dy and 14 is 2 × dx. The outlined cells are the next candidates; the solid orange cells are already drawn.
